主要内容: Blonder Tongue Laboratories, Inc. (the "Company") and its subsidiary R. L. Drake Holdings, LLC entered into a First Amendment to the Amended and Restated Senior Subordinated Convertible Loan and Security Agreement. The Amendment eliminated Section 4.4(e)(ii) of the Loan Agreement, which adjusted the conversion price for Subordinated Lenders in the event the Company issued additional shares at a lower price. As a result, the Company anticipates recording a change in derivative liability (expense) of approximately $142,000, additional interest expense of approximately $177,000, and additional paid-in capital of approximately $402,000 during the first quarter of 2017. The Amendment is attached as Exhibit 10.1 and incorporated by reference into Item 2.03, which discusses the creation of a direct financial obligation under the Loan Agreement.
